seo_title: Free Online Electrical Wiring Simulator | ElectraSim
seo_description: Build house-wiring circuits with MCBs, RCDs, RCBOs, switches, sockets and faults. Free in your browser—no download or sign-up.
hero_description: ElectraSim is a free online electrical wiring simulator for building and testing realistic circuits directly in your browser.
features_heading: Everything you need to learn, build & simulate
features_description: A complete electrical circuit toolkit — all running locally in your browser, no server, no cloud, no account needed.

features.title: Drag & Drop Components
features.body: Place MCB breakers, switches, light bulbs, fans, motors and sockets from the palette. Components snap to a grid for clean, professional layouts.

features.title: Real-Time Simulation
features.body: Hit Run and watch electricity flow instantly. Energised wires animate, bulbs light up, fans spin. Toggle switches and see changes propagate live.

features.title: Fault Detection
features.body: Trace open and short circuits, then inject reverse-polarity and missing-earth faults for practice. Fault states highlight clearly for faster diagnosis.

features.title: Smart Wire Routing
features.body: Click a port to start wiring — ElectraSim auto-routes orthogonal wires around components. Custom multi-step wiring also supported.

features.title: Multi-Select & Align
features.body: Shift-click or drag-select multiple components. Align left, center, right, top or bottom with one click for professional diagrams.

features.title: Import, Export & Share
features.body: Save your circuit as JSON, export as SVG or PNG, or generate a shareable URL. Your work is autosaved locally and survives page reloads.

how_description: No account, no download, no setup. Open ElectraSim and start building immediately.

steps.title: Open the app
steps.body: Click "Launch the Simulator". It loads instantly — works offline after the first visit.

steps.title: Place components
steps.body: Open the Components panel and click any component — MCB, switch, bulb, fan — to place it on the canvas.

steps.title: Wire them up
steps.body: Click a port dot on one component, then a port on another. ElectraSim routes the wire automatically.

steps.title: Run & learn
steps.body: Press Run to simulate. Toggle switches, add faults, and see exactly how your circuit behaves.

usecases_description: ElectraSim is designed for anyone who wants to understand or teach how electrical circuits work.

use_cases.title: Students
use_cases.body: Use a beginner-friendly circuit simulator free of charge. Practice house wiring online without risk of shocks or blown fuses.

use_cases.title: Teachers
use_cases.body: Create live circuit demonstrations in the classroom. Share circuits via URL for homework assignments.

use_cases.title: Electricians
use_cases.body: Use it as electrician training software to prototype layouts, demonstrate fault scenarios, and validate circuit logic before going on-site.

use_cases.title: Hobbyists
use_cases.body: Experiment with circuit ideas, test different configurations, and learn by doing at your own pace.

blog_heading: Learn electrical wiring the easy way
blog_description: Step-by-step guides to help you learn electrical wiring online — from household circuits to fault detection. Written for beginners and professionals alike.
cta_heading: Ready to build your first circuit?
cta_description: The free virtual electrical lab used by students, teachers and electricians. Simulate circuits online — no download, no sign-up, no risk.
